data.name: Nimble Climber
data.description: When an investigator with this talent fails a Climb check by 5 or more, she can immediately make another Climb check at the surface's base DC +10. If successful, she stops her fall by clinging onto the surface. The investigator does not take falling damage when she stops her fall in this manner.
